# GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}/public_members

List an organization's public members. Always shows only public members regardless of authentication.

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none · **ID:** `ep-071`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## Response

**200** — []*api.User

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | user ID |
| `login` | string | username |
| `full_name` | string | full name |
| `email` | string | email (may be placeholder if private) |
| `avatar_url` | string | avatar URL |
| `html_url` | string | profile URL |

- **404** — Organization does not exist
